description: Step-by-step breakdown of phase 1 (Authorization Service) from project-roadmap.json, sequenced in the order the steps were actually built.
note: docs/design/ (start at docs/design/README.md) is the source of truth for the data model, API shape, invariants, ADRs, cost model, and security posture. Where this roadmap and the design doc disagree, the design doc wins. This roadmap stays high level; step-by-step implementation detail belongs in code and PRs, not here.

status_legend.in_progress: Started; specifics recorded in the step's `notes` field.

steps.name: Authorizations POST endpoint
steps.goal: Stand up a basic POST authorizations endpoint with basic error handling.

steps.name: Merchant POST endpoint
steps.goal: Stand up a basic POST merchants endpoint.

steps.name: Cognito authorizer and user pool
steps.goal: Add a Cognito user pool and wire it up as the API Gateway authorizer.

steps.name: Account creation on sign-up
steps.goal: Add a Lambda, triggered by Cognito, that creates the account record in DynamoDB when a user signs up.

steps.name: Cloud testing and HTTP files
steps.goal: Test the deployed stack end to end on AWS and fix whatever breaks.
steps.notes: Add HTTP files (tests/http/) so cloud testing is easy to repeat. Start testing on cloud from this step forward; steps 1-4 were not tested on cloud because account creation didn't exist yet, so this step also covers closing that gap.

steps.name: Authorizations endpoint uses transactions
steps.goal: Update the POST authorizations endpoint to write via a DynamoDB transaction.

steps.name: Idempotency for authorizations
steps.goal: Add idempotency to the POST authorizations endpoint.

steps.name: Deposit service
steps.goal: Add the POST /deposits endpoint and Deposit Service Lambda, crediting an account against the EXTERNAL#funding counterparty via a DynamoDB transaction, built on the idempotency support from step 6.

steps.name: Capture authorization endpoint
steps.goal: Add the capture authorization endpoint, built on the idempotency support from step 6, and verify the ledger property holds after a capture.

steps.name: Void authorization endpoint
steps.goal: Add the void authorization endpoint, built on the idempotency support from step 6.

steps.name: Tracing and logging
steps.goal: Add tracing and improve logging across the authorization service.

steps.name: DynamoDB encryption
steps.goal: Encrypt the ledger table with a CMK.

steps.name: Expired hold sweeper
steps.goal: Add the Lambda that sweeps and releases expired authorization holds.
